verdict.rationale: Vue.js's site points users to /llms.txt for optimized Markdown documentation and /llms-full.txt for the full documentation bundle. An independent probe confirmed https://vuejs.org/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured table of contents, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. Missing for 10: hands-on verification of the /llms-full.txt bundle, and any agent-specific guidance beyond the llms.txt index.
